name: Sugahiro Yumie
source:
A former high school teacher who reeks of mature womanhood.

She used to be married to a fellow teacher who was a few years younger than her.

After her husband's sudden death, she resigned in shock and took over her mother's coffee shop. She has not had sex in five years.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momofero/product/hitoduma/index.html]official site[/url]]
